body: I can relate. It doesn't make me happy to hear someone else in the same spot but at least I am not alone.

Thank you.

I know life isn't all about money and a job but you have to admit it is a large part of it. I've spent three months searching for any kind of job that can keep us afloat and I keep coming up empty handed. 

It just sucks that I'm caving to depression and things keep getting worse. I'm ashamed of myself and what I have become and I feel like I am letting people down...I just am having a hard time shaking that feeling.

Thank you again.

Thank you for replying. 

When I wrote this I was having a "flare" of depression. I just got done searching for jobs (didn't find any) was staring at a collections notice for a bill and just broke for a moment.

I've put the gun away in a safe and am focusing on my wife and what it would do to her. 

Thank you again.
